g.text: QuakeShift: live detection and resource-aware adaptation
Associate by travel time/location; upsert event
[Eco skips station or trigger does not fire]
Read carbon intensity, queue lag, resource usage
Read available capacity and rollout status
[Resource profile or replica count must change]
Check rollout; restore prior profile on failure
revise existing events or add missed events.
Stable job IDs and idempotent writes make retries safe.
